topic: The Fundamental Bridge: The Relationship Between Integrals and Derivatives

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Velocity-Distance Analogy
lecture_lines: Velocity tracks how fast a squirrel runs.
Total distance is the area under velocity.
Integral finds the total distance accumulated.
animations: Display a car [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/car.png] at position 0, color #FFFFFF.
Draw distance as area under velocity, color #FFFF00.
Transition position as distance grows, color #FF00FF.
Final state: position equals integral, color #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Rates of Change & Accumulation
lecture_lines: Derivatives measure the slope of a curve.
Integrals calculate the area under a curve.
They are inverse operations of each other.
animations: Show rate of change (derivative) slope [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/slope.svg] in #FF0000.
Toggle between slope [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/slope.svg] and area [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/area.svg], highlighting relationship.

sections.title: The Fundamental Theorem: Connecting the Dots
lecture_lines: The Fundamental Theorem connects these two concepts.
Integration and differentiation effectively cancel out.
Like multiplication and division, they are opposites.
animations: Display integral F(x) = integral f(t)dt, color #FFFF00.
Show F'(x) equals f(x) dynamic connection.
Final equation summary with highlight, color #FFFFFF, represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/abacus.svg].

sections.title: Visual Proof: The Moving Accumulation Function
lecture_lines: An accumulation function grows as it moves.
Its rate of growth is the function's height.
Thus, the derivative is the function itself.
animations: Sweep vertical line through area, color #00FFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]

sections.title: Summary & Practical Application
lecture_lines: Derivatives tell us rates of change.
They are vital tools for modern engineering.
animations: Recap the core derivative-integral link, color #FFFFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bridge.svg]
